title: Fix pls
body: The app is awesome, but please fix the timer in the notification shade 🙏. The animation lags a bit, and pausing has a slight delay.

title: Amazing
body: Totally worth the 5 bucks if you’re serious about self improvement. Or if you have adhd. Or if you’re just a human being in general. I’d recommend reading the book “atomic habits” to accompany this app.
